t.why: It is fighting armed groups across much of its territory, expelled French troops and moved closer to Russia.
t.rel: It formed the Alliance of Sahel States with Mali and Niger and left ECOWAS. More and more people are fleeing armed attacks into southern neighbors such as Ivory Coast and Ghana.
t.know: It hosts FESPACO, Africa's largest film festival.
t.etext: Gold makes up most exports, and it grows a lot of cotton. Attacks by armed groups and a string of coups have made mining areas insecure.
